answer: Picture a nebula of fake agents drifting into a marketplace. One defense is a refundable bond: every new identity must lock tokens for ninety days before its votes or ratings count, and peers who catch it colluding can slash the deposit. An attacker spinning up a thousand puppets must freeze a thousand bonds and risk losing all of them in a single gale of exposure. Reaching the summit of a reputation leaderboard becomes a costly climb rather than a cheap script.
